channel.title: Google Ads & Meta Ads updates
channel.description: Plain-English summaries of new features, renames, deprecations and policy changes on Google Ads and Meta Ads.

item.title: [Google Ads] Google Ads Budget Recommendation Change With Forecast
item.description:
Google Ads · Feature update · Impact: Low

Google Ads is showing some advertisers not just a recommendation with the ability to make a change on that recommendation but it is tied to the advertiser's forecast. It shows your projected weekly conversion value and adds that your campaign is limited by budget, and that you should spend more to hit the forecast.

Source: Search Engine Roundtable
